[vtc] Reject e2eeEnabled true-to-false downgrade
Spec (3cbb0c4): draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md L450: "a moderator MAY change it from `false` to `true` via update ... The server SHOULD reject an update from `true` to `false` with `invalidProperties` naming `e2eeEnabled`, so that participants never have to detect a downgrade."
Code: crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/call.rs:466-556; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/call.rs:72
Now: update_call only gates e2eeEnabled on moderator status. A moderator can patch it from true to false.
Change: In update_call, when the call's e2ee_enabled is true and the patch sets e2eeEnabled to false, return invalid(&["e2eeEnabled"], ...).
